subject: Gate Zero readiness: private deployment priming artifacts & smoke evidence
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: sarah.turner@acme-ops.com
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Gate Zero readiness: private deployment priming artifacts & smoke evidence

Team —

Attached is the consolidated "Gate Zero" checklist and the KV cache warmup log from this morning's priming run. Quick summary:

- Network: BGP sessions established between Acme edge and our on-prem gateway, no flap events in the last 90 minutes.
- Ingress: TLS handshakes successful, cert chain validated against customer CA.
- KV warm-up: initial prefix priming completed (see kv_warmup_log.csv). Peak warmup token rate ~1.8M tokens/min.
- Observability: telemetry tags are present for canary routes; traces are sampling at 10%.

Open items before we call green:
1) Finalize ACL exception for Acme ops CIDR — Hannah on network ACL rules (ETA 2 hours).
2) Confirm HSM key rotation window is closed (Marissa to confirm with legal if keys are approved for the private control plane).
3) Run one full ramp test (10m steady-state at 75% target QPS) and surface any 5xx spikes.

Attachments: gate_zero_checklist.pdf, kv_warmup_log.csv, priming-evidence-screenshot-1.png

Asks: please reply with explicit greenlight or list of blockers. If green, we will signal the activation bridge for a 13:00 PDT canary.

Thanks,
Mateo
Mateo Alvarez
Senior Delivery Engineer, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: sarah.turner@acme-ops.com
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 10:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Gate Zero readiness: private deployment priming artifacts & smoke evidence

Thanks Mateo — solid summary. A couple of notes from my side after reviewing the checklist:

- Storage: our S3-backed objectstore shows transient 503s at 08:46 but all retries succeeded; I've flagged it in the checklist under "storage_postprime". Recommend we keep a closer eye during the 75% ramp.
- Healthchecks: control-plane leader election had a ~3s pause when we toggled the firewall rule for testing. This is within tolerances but worth noting.
- Autoscaler: one of the scale-up policies did not trigger during a simulated spike in the lab (policy ID autoscale-edge-3). I will run a repro and update this thread by 11:30.

Blocking items: only the autoscaler repro for me. If autoscaler behaves as expected in the next run, I am +1 to proceed to canary.

Monica
Monica Patel
Ops Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: sarah.turner@acme-ops.com
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 11:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Gate Zero readiness: private deployment priming artifacts & smoke evidence

On Tue, May 4, 2027 at 10:30 AM Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks Mateo — solid summary. A couple of notes from my side after reviewing the checklist:
> - Storage: our S3-backed objectstore shows transient 503s at 08:46 but all retries succeeded; I've flagged it in the checklist under "storage_postprime".

Quick follow-up from networking:
- ACL exception: Hannah, please confirm once the Acme CIDR 198.51.100.0/24 is added to the private-gw-allowlist. I validated the route-map and the BFD sessions are stable.
- MTU: we observed one PMTU drop on a single path (path-3) during a jumbo frame test; we've lowered jumbo to 9000->8500 on that fabric to avoid fragmentation.
- Load balancing: we toggled session persistence settings and saw stable sticky sessions for canary cookie.

KV warmup note: kv_warmup_log.csv shows successful priming for the top-20 prefixes and sustained cache hit rate >92% after warmup. That should keep the first-hour token cost steady.

Irene
Irene Choi
Network Lead, Private Deployments
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Turner <sarah.turner@acme-ops.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 04 May 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Gate Zero readiness: private deployment priming artifacts & smoke evidence

Thanks all — Acme ops ran the ingress-to-model smoke at 13:00 PDT canary as requested. Results:
- End-to-end p95 latency: 142ms (baseline 135ms)
- Errors: two transient 502s during 13:04–13:06; both were retried client-side and succeeded. Logs attached as brief stubs in our ticketing system.
- Observability: traces show KV miss rate at 7% during initial 90s of traffic, but fell to <1% after warmup.

We didn't hit the autoscaler threshold during this pass. If you want a higher-pressure run I can spin a 30m steady 90% QPS test at 15:30.

Sarah Turner
Lead Site Reliability Engineer, Acme Commerce

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: raj.legal@globex.com
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 17:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Gate Zero readiness: private deployment priming artifacts & smoke evidence

All — quick closure. Thanks for the fast turn on autoscale repro, Monica; and thanks Sarah for the canary evidence. Summary and actions:

- Acceptance: Canary passed for Gate Zero. Small transient 502s acceptable (client-side retries covered). Observability and KV hit targets met.
- Action items closed: ACL exception applied (Hannah) and HSM rotation window verified by legal (Raj).
- Next step: schedule the 30m pressure run tomorrow for production burn-in (Marissa to coordinate with Acme).

Links: Gate-zero evidence bundle and runbook are here: https://drive.redwood.internal/g/Acme/gate-zero-evidence-20270504

Thanks team — greenlight to move to phased traffic shift tomorrow at 09:00 PDT pending the 30m burn-in.

Marissa Cole
Head of Private Deployments, Redwood Inference
Attachment stubs: acceptance-summary.txt (1.2KB), priming-screenshots.zip (3 files)
